description: This file defines a custom exception class 'FeatureDefinitionEmptyException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It is thrown when a feature definition is set to an empty array, indicating a validation error. The class extends 'DittoRuntimeException' and includes builder patterns, static factory methods, and relevant metadata.
